Label.MessageToUser.BanEvasion: This account is linked to an account banned for a severe violation of our Community Standards. The violation can be appealed using the previously banned account.
Label.MessageToUser.Harassment: Boiby does not permit bullying or targeted harassment towards other users in any form.
Label.MessageToUser.Spam: Boiby does not allow repetitive, unwanted, and/or automated high-volume messaging or posting.
Label.MessageToUser.HateSpeech: Any content or behaviour that promotes hate speech or discriminatory content is not permitted on Boiby.
Label.MessageToUser.SexualContent: Boiby prohibits users from uploading or discussing highly suggestive or sexually explicit content.
Label.MessageToUser.Scamming: Boiby prohibits any attempts to scam or deceive users for financial gain or personal information through any means.
Label.MessageToUser.ChildEndangerment: Your account has been permanently banned due to violating Boiby's Minor Safety policy. Our policies prohibit this sort of content and behavior. In circumstances where we believe users may be in danger, we may report the activity to relevant authorities.
Label.MessageToUser.TerrorismExtremism: Your account has been permanently banned due to violating Boiby's Terrorism & Violent Extremism policy. Our policies prohibit this sort of content and behavior. In circumstances where we believe users may be in danger, we may report the activity to relevant authorities.
Label.MessageToUser.Copyright: We received a copyright removal request for your content. After reviewing the request, our moderation team has removed this content. If this was a mistake, you can contest the removal request by submitting a counter-notice by following our guidelines.
Label.MessageToUser.PII: Boiby prohibits users to share or ask for personally identifiable information (PII).
Label.MessageToUser.Chargebacks: Your account has been suspended due to unauthorized or disputed charges.
Label.MessageToUser.PaymentAbuse: Your account has been moderated for payment abuse such as fraudulent transactions or misuse of payment features.
Label.MessageToUser.MisusingBoibySystems: Boiby does not permit any misuse of our platform's report tools or systems.
Label.MessageToUser.DangerousActivities: Boiby prohibits the encouragement of or participation in real-life dangerous activities among users.
Label.MessageToUser.SuspiciousAccountPat: Your account has been suspended due to suspicious account activity patterns.
Label.MessageToUser.AccountTheft: Your account has been permanently banned for involvement in account theft or unauthorized access to other users' accounts.
Label.MessageToUser.CompromisedAccount: This account has been closed as comproimised. If you believe this to be a mistake, please send an appeal.
Label.MessageToUser.RepeatedRefunds: Your account has been suspended due to repeated refund requests that violate our refund policy.
Label.MessageToUser.Dating: Boiby prohibits romantic behaviors such as dating or kissing on the platform to ensure the safety of all users.
Label.MessageToUser.PoliticalContent: Boiby prohibits content that promotes political figures or entities in order to maintain a neutral platform for all users.
Label.MessageToUser.IllegalRegulated: Boiby prohibits content that involves illegal activities or regulated goods and services.
Label.MessageToUser.SensitiveEvents: Boiby prohibits content that exploits or takes advantage of real-world sensitive events for personal gain or attention.
Label.MessageToUser.Misinformation: Boiby prohibits the spread of false or misleading information that can cause harm to individuals or communities.
Label.MessageToUser.DisruptiveAudio: Boiby prohibits audio content that is disruptive or harmful to the user experience on the platform.
Label.MessageToUser.UndisclosedAds: Boiby prohibits undisclosed advertisements or promotional content that mislead or harm users.
Label.MessageToUser.GenericViolation: Your account has been moderated for violating the Terms of Use for inappropriate behaviour or content.
Label.MessageToUser.Username: This username is not appropriate for Boiby.
Label.MessageToUser.DisplayName: This display name is not appropriate for Boiby.
Label.MessageToUser.Impersonation: Boiby prohibits attempts to mislead users by impersonating other people’s identity or likeness.
Label.MessageToUser.OffPlatformBehaviour: Your account has been moderated for off-platform behaviour that violates our Terms of Use.
Label.MessageToUser.AccountForBreakingRu: Do not create accounts just for the purpose of breaking the rules or harassing others.

Description.FollowFuture: To keep our community safe and fun for everyone, please follow the rules in the future.
Description.PolicyIntro: To keep our community safe, all users are required to follow Boiby's Community Standards.
Description.BullyDetail: It's against the rules to say mean things to someone or about another person.
Description.BullyImportance: To keep our community fun for everyone, don’t use words or actions that are intended to harm or bully others.
Heading.RuleExplanation.PIIHeader: No sharing or requesting personal information
Description.PIIDetail: It is against the rules to share your personal information or to ask others to share their private personal data.
Description.PIIImportance: Sharing or soliciting personally identifiable information (PII) can lead to harassment or identity theft.
Description.SpamDetail: Spam involves repetitive, unwanted, or automated messages or posts.
Description.SpamImportance: Spamming harms the experience for others and makes it hard to follow conversations.
Description.ExtortionDetail: Threatening or coercing others for money, favors, or to gain something you want is not allowed.
Description.ExtortionImportance: Threats and extortion are not allowed because they threaten users' safety and privacy.
Description.ViolentDetail: Content that depicts or promotes serious physical harm, graphic violence, or gore is not allowed.
Description.ViolentImportance: Graphic or violent content can be traumatic or upsetting, especially for users under 18.
Description.DatingDetail: Romantic behaviors like kissing or dating are not allowed.
Description.DatingImportance: Our community includes users under the age of 18. Solicitation and online dating puts these users at risk.
Description.HarmfulDetail: Content that encourages, instructs, or praises dangerous activities isn't allowed.
Description.HarmfulImportance: Encouraging or providing instructions for dangerous activities can cause real-world harm.
Label.AgreeToRules: I agree to know and follow the rules
Heading.SecondChance: Avoid a suspension this one time?
Heading.Subheading.SecondChance: Learn this rule and go back to using Boiby.
Description.SecondChance: Since you've behaved responsibly in the past, you can avoid a suspension this one time by reviewing our rules.
